info.name: Health Tracker
info.summary: Record and visualise lab test results from your health reports
info.description:
Health Tracker lets you import medical lab reports (CBC, lipid profiles, vitamin panels and more) as images or PDFs, OCR-extracts their text and uses a language model to pull out the structured test data — patient, date, doctor, lab and every individual test with its value, unit, reference range and a severity tier inferred from the sheet's own flags.
* 📄 Add files or folders from your Nextcloud; processing is tracked end to end * 🤖 Uses the Nextcloud Task Processing API — the admin enables an OCR and a Chat provider * 📊 Chronological results table with colour-coded severity * 📈 Per-test trend charts over time (e.g. Platelets count) * 🔒 Each user sees only their own reports
info.author: Nextcloud contributors
